coverage: ROSTER. The angle named two things. (1) Elliott's reread series: the brief said 539 entries were already on disk under prose-research/hobb-raw/ — FALSE on this machine (that directory does not exist; the Hobb raw dir sweep/hobb-raw holds 104 files with exactly one Elliott page, and only 5 reread entries existed anywhere in the scratchpad). The corpus was therefore fetched fresh: sitemap.xml returned 200 but carried only 420 of the entries (capped at 1001 posts), so the site's own wordpress.com REST endpoint was used, returning all 541 posts tagged hobb-reread (Entry 0 to Entry 539) with full published content; 5 numbered gaps, 4 recovered by search, only Entry 127 (Ship of Magic, out of scope) unrecovered; API content verified identical to the independently curl-fetched rendered page for Entry 226. (2) Oliver: fetched and read entire from the open-access Mythlore PDF on disk. NOT FOUND / BLOCKED: none — every named item was read. EXPANSION: bibliography chasing from Oliver and Elliott's Fedwren Project yielded one further substantive primary (Ekman and Taylor, JFA 32.2, on disk, read — it does not discuss Hobb); lateral searches yielded Outcalt's Substack reading list (reader, substantive) and four non-substantive pages (rpgstorytellers, an uncredited house byline whose claim the census contradicts; Reactor's epigraph essay, 68 'epigraph' hits and 0 'Hobb'; nerds-of-a-feather, 0 'epigraph'; Page by Paige, 0 'epigraph'), and Elliott's own three scholarly papers contain 0 occurrences of 'epigraph'. SUBSTANTIVE PER ROUTE: named roster 2, bibliography chasing 2, lateral search 1, plus 38 individual Elliott entries cited by claim (39 substantive sources of 44 read). Stop rule met: the last two searches surfaced nothing mentioning both Hobb and the epigraphs. THE CENSUS: 314 entries classified (Farseer 100, Tawny Man 94, Fitz and the Fool 120); 285 yielded a document description, 29 did not (16 no frame matched, 13 narrative-only). Elliott never writes the word 'epigraph' in any of the 541 posts, so the unit measured is his description of each chapter's opening document, not Hobb's text, and every claim says so. Files: sweep/found-hobb-epigraph-census.json, sweep/find-hobb-epigraph-census.md, working corpus in sweep/epi/.
